device_type.description: PTP device type; for ptp4l-e2e, always 'transparent_clock' or 'boundary_clock'.

interface.description: Primary network interface to use for PTP communication (must support hardware timestamping).

slave_only.description: If true, this node will only act as a slave (never become master).

clock_class.description: Clock class (0–125). Lower = higher quality. Use 6 (GPS) or 7 (atomic) for grandmaster; 128 = uncertain.

clock_accuracy.description: Clock accuracy code (e.g., 0x2A=100ns, 0x2B=250ns, 0x2C=1us). See IEEE 802.1AS-2011 Table 10-3.

offset_log_max.description: Log2 of max offset to log in seconds. -1 = auto. Typical: -3 (125ms), -6 (1.56µs).

timebase.description: Timebase for offset/delay calculations: 'phc' (PTP Hardware Clock) or 'system' (system clock).

hwts.description: Enable hardware timestamping for precise PTP timing. Required for sub-100 ns accuracy.

swts.description: Enable software timestamping (fallback if hardware timestamping unavailable).

domain_number.description: PTP domain number (0–127). All nodes in the same domain must use the same value.

priority1.description: Priority1 (0–254) — used in BMC election. Lower = higher preference for master.

priority2.description: Priority2 (0–254) — tie-breaker when Priority1 is equal (e.g., same MAC).

slave_only_clocks.description: Number of slave-only clocks directly connected behind this transparent clock (used in priority chain).

announce_interval.description: Log2 of Announce interval in seconds. e.g., 1 → 2s, 0 → 1s, -1 → 500ms.

sync_interval.description: Log2 of Sync interval in seconds. e.g., 0 → 1s, -1 → 500ms, -2 → 250ms, -4 → 62.5ms.

delay_interval.description: Log2 of Delay_Req interval in seconds. Typically same as sync_interval.

signal_interval.description: Log2 of Signaling interval in seconds. e.g., 1 → 2s.

mgmt_interval.description: Log2 of Management interval in seconds. Set to 0 (1s) for active management, -1 (500ms) for frequent updates.

announcements_before_master.description: Number of Announce messages received before becoming master candidate.

announcements_before_reset.description: Missed Announces before resetting master state.

ptp_dst_mac.description: Destination MAC for PTP packets (default = PTP multicast). Use '00:00:00:00:00:00' to disable QoS.

bmc.description: Enable Best Master Clock algorithm. Disable only if using static configuration.

logging.description: Enable logging to syslog (recommended for production).

clock_description_file.description: Path to optional file containing clock description string (e.g., model, serial).

uds_address.description: Unix Domain Socket path for ptp4l control interface.

uds_port.description: Port for UDS (0 = auto-assign). Usually left as 0.

initial_delay_ns.description: Initial guess of path delay in nanoseconds (used before auto-delay estimation).

delay_thresh_ns.description: Maximum acceptable estimated delay (ns) before flagging path anomaly.

auto_delay.description: Enable automatic estimation of path delay via Delay_Req/Resp exchange.

allow_fallback_to_p2p.description: Fallback to Peer-to-Peer delay mechanism if E2E fails (not recommended for strict E2E configs).

additional_interfaces.description: List of additional interfaces to monitor for PTP traffic (e.g., for redundant paths or multi-homing).

priority.description: Interface priority for BMC election (higher = more preferred).

master_only.description: If true, interface allowed to become master only (not slave).

slave_only.description: If true, interface allowed to be slave only (not master).
